note: Acceptance specification; live state and evidence are in WorkManagement.

items.title: Correct SQL pagination and legacy page validation
acceptance: No gaps between pages; bounded page size; stable key order; no full-table materialization for a requested page; regression tests

items.title: Resource definitions, separate DTOs and transactional concurrency
acceptance: Opt-in shared resource definition and explicit mapping; optimistic concurrency version; SQL Server pessimistic transaction lock with cancellation/bounded wait; same-context entity/translation/Outbox commit; real rollback and race tests

items.title: Generic CRUD resource endpoints and runtime Doctor
acceptance: Enabled operations and per-operation policies enforced; 400/404/409 contracts; DI and EF metadata checked without writes; read-only runtime report; executable sample with translation and Outbox

items.title: Feature generator, companion integration and release evidence
acceptance: Runnable neo new feature command with no overwrite and input validation; generated project builds and runs; generator uses shared CRUD definition; MCP source retrieval, Persian guide and skill synchronized; local and SQL CI evidence recorded
